mapper.sql: rt.*, m.code AS mat_code, m.name AS mat_name
FROM mdm_route rt LEFT JOIN mdm_mat m ON m.id = rt.mat_id AND m.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT rt.id AS rt_id, rt.mat_id AS rt_mat_id, rt.version AS rt_version, rt.status AS rt_status, rt.effective_date AS rt_effective_date, rt.expiry_date AS rt_expiry_date, rt.remark AS rt_remark, rt.create_time AS rt_create_time, m.code AS mat_code, m.name AS mat_name, ro.id AS ro_id, ro.route_id AS ro_route_id, ro.seq AS ro_seq, ro.op_id AS ro_op_id, ro.wc_id AS ro_wc_id, ro.parallel_group AS ro_parallel_group, ro.key_flag AS ro_key_flag, ro.fai_flag AS ro_fai_flag, ro.remark AS ro_remark, ro.create_time AS ro_create_time, COUNT(rom.id) OVER (PARTITION BY ro.id) AS ro_material_count, o.code AS op_code, o.name AS op_name, w.code AS wc_code, w.name AS wc_name, rom.id AS rom_id, rom.route_op_id AS rom_route_op_id, rom.mat_id AS rom_mat_id, rom.qty AS rom_qty, rom.uom_id AS rom_uom_id, rom.remark AS rom_remark, rom.create_time AS rom_create_time, mm.code AS rom_mat_code, mm.name AS rom_mat_name, mm.spec AS rom_mat_spec, u.code AS rom_uom_code, u.name AS rom_uom_name FROM mdm_route rt LEFT JOIN mdm_mat m ON m.id = rt.mat_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_route_op ro ON ro.route_id = rt.id AND ro.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_op o ON o.id = ro.op_id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_wc w ON w.id = ro.wc_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_route_op_mat rom ON rom.route_op_id = ro.id AND rom.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_mat mm ON mm.id = rom.mat_id AND mm.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_uom u ON u.id = rom.uom_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE rt.deleted = 0 AND rt.id = #{id} ORDER BY ro.seq ASC, rom.id ASC
